answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 31462 Country: India Title: If a person takes bath in naked position in bath room, but he performs bath with all three ferz which is required for bath. Question: If a person takes bath in naked position in bath room, but he performs bath with all three ferz which is required for bath. my question is that is it necesary to do wazu after naked bath or wazu will be completed. Answer ID: 31462 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 710/L=259/tl=1432) In the course of ghusl, wudhu also takes place. Ghusl done wearing lungi or naked does not have any adverse effect on wudhu. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
